description: This Java class 'VisitHandler' manages user visit tracking, including session visit creation, visitor identification via cookies, and updating visit and visitor data in the database within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: VisitHandler
classes.description: A utility class for managing user visit and visitor tracking, including session visit creation, updating, and cookie management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setUserLogin
methods.description: Associates a user login with the current session visit and visitor records, updating relevant fields in the database.

methods.name: getVisitId
methods.description: Retrieves the current session's visit ID.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a visit record associated with the current session, initializing it with request and session data.

methods.name: getVisitor
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a visitor record based on cookies and session data, managing visitor identification and cookie refresh.
